$Comment: The Flaming Horseman's Greaves, one of the five pieces the Horseman's Hoard can pay (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json) and the stronger twin of the plain Horseman's Greaves, whose model, texture and icon they share. A member of the Hallowed set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json) and of the Flaming Hallowed set (Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Hallowed.json). Their armour is the game's ancient steel greaves' (the same Physical and Projectile resistance and Health), with their recipe left out (they are never crafted) and twice that piece's durability (150). On top of that they ward off Fire (DamageResistance.Fire, the Burning Jack Helm's shape, 0.08 is 8%) and raise DamageBonus_Fire, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Fire damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so a Lantern Bomb or any fire weapon hits 8% harder with them on. Light is the hotter glow of the Burning Jack Helm. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent.
